digest.component_or_area: model class provider qualification and resolution
propositions: A configured provider is silently discarded when a model id contains a colon (the canonical Bedrock versioned form with ':0' suffix), because _resolve_target incorrectly treats any colon as a provider-qualifier separator.
The bug affects canonical Bedrock ids like 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0' but not unversioned aliases like 'us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6', allowing the defect to go unnoticed.

The decision of whether a string is already provider-qualified is made by two independent colon-scanning implementations (in _resolve_target and infer_provider) that fail identically rather than through one shared function.
An explicitly configured provider must be checked first before scanning the model string for qualifiers, so that no punctuation in a model id can overrule or discard an explicit instruction.
The provider-qualified decision must be made against registered provider names rather than by shape heuristics, to provide actionable diagnostics and prevent silent fallback for typo'd providers.
